subject: Sharing images created in shiny to facebook/twitter/linkedin

messages.author: a1bf76ab9a5a2d4b
messages.subject: Sharing images created in shiny to facebook/twitter/linkedin
parts:
Does anyone have any experience with sharing Shiny-generated plots to a social media site using their javascript library?
After hours of trying, I'm running into tons of problems and still can't figure out any of them...

One of my problems is how to send the image? Shiny creates the images as base64 encoded, so the images don't have a URL. Facebook (as far as I can tell) only accepts public URLs to images, so the shiny image needs to be uploaded somewhere that's public. I can't find a way to send the Facebook javascript SDK a base64- Has anyone done this? I suppose it's possible to "download" the image to the server at a location that's publicly available and share that URL. I also tried uploading the encoded image to imgur programatically and then using imgur's URL, which worked, but seems excessive. I'm wondering if someone has another suggestion.

With Twitter and LinkedIn I don't think from my 4-hour research that it's possible to share an image from JavaScript. This is not a shiny-specific issue, but if anyone has done this before any tips are appreciated :)
